datasets.dataset_name: Newfoundland and Labrador Grants / Public Payments — NOT FOUND
datasets.error: NL Grants: no current, machine-readable, whole-of-government Newfoundland and Labrador grants/payments/public-accounts source exists. The province's open data portal (opendata.gov.nl.ca, 71 tabular datasets, mirrored on open.canada.ca under organization "nl-tnl", 76 datasets) contains only stale single-fiscal-year snapshots from 2013-2016 (e.g. "Grant payments over $250,000 2014-2015", last modified 2015-09-28 — over a decade stale) — none are current or whole-of-government. NL's own Public Accounts are published as PDF only, not CSV/XLSX. This is a genuine data-availability/currency gap, not a fetch failure — see module header comment for the full search performed.

sources_checked.source: opendata.gov.nl.ca (task candidate portal) — "Explore Open Data" tabular datasets listing
sources_checked.result: Resolves and is browsable (bespoke .NET portal, not CKAN/Socrata). Fully enumerated: 71 tabular datasets. Financial/grant-adjacent titles found: "Grant payments over $250,000 2014-2015" (Dept. of Finance — the only candidate resembling a whole-of-government supplier/grant payments disclosure), "Municipal Operating Grant Allocations", "Value of Annual Operating Grants provided to CYFS' Community Partners", "Community Enhancement Employment Program Annual Project List and Funding Provided".

sources_checked.source: open.canada.ca federal aggregator, organization=nl-tnl (76 datasets, mirrors the above 1:1)
sources_checked.result: Cross-checked via CKAN package_search — same 76 datasets, confirming opendata.gov.nl.ca is fully indexed and no additional NL financial dataset exists on the federal aggregator either.

sources_checked.source: "Grant payments over $250,000 2014-2015" — closest candidate to a whole-of-government dataset
sources_checked.result: Confirmed stale via its own CKAN/portal metadata: temporal coverage "April 1, 2014 - March 31, 2015", released 2015-09-28, modified 2015-09-28 — never updated in over a decade. Not a live/maintained dataset; publishing it as current "Grants" data would misrepresent it. Small file (12KB CSV) suggesting a very limited one-time disclosure, not an ongoing program.

sources_checked.source: Other 3 grant-related NL datasets ("Municipal Operating Grant Allocations", CYFS operating grants, Community Enhancement Employment Program)
sources_checked.result: All single fiscal-year snapshots from 2013-2016, never updated since, and each single-department/single-program in scope — not a whole-of-government payments dataset comparable to AB's grant disclosure, BC's supplier payments, or NB's Combined Supplier and Grant Payments.
